description: This file defines the DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy class within the OrangeHRM system, implementing the purge method to delete specific entity records based on employee number, targeting subordinate and supervisor relationships.

classes.name: DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for purging report data related to employees' subordinate and supervisor relationships in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Deletes entities associated with the given employee number, considering subordinate and supervisor roles.
